sql_query: SELECT MIN(fg_pct_away)  FROM game;

natural_query: How many times has a team won while scoring fewer than 80 points?
sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*)  FROM game  WHERE (pts_home < 80 AND wl_home = 'W')     OR (pts_away < 80 AND wl_away = 'W');

natural_query: How many times has a team lost while shooting over 55% from the field?
sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*)  FROM game  WHERE (fg_pct_home > 0.55 AND wl_home = 'L')     OR (fg_pct_away > 0.55 AND wl_away = 'L');

natural_query: How many games were decided by more than 40 points?
sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*)  FROM game  WHERE ABS(pts_home - pts_away) > 40;

natural_query: What is the most steals recorded by an away team in a game?
sql_query: SELECT MAX(stl_away)  FROM game;

natural_query: How many games ended with both teams scoring at least 120 points?
sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*)  FROM game  WHERE pts_home >= 120 AND pts_away >= 120;

natural_query: How many games had at least one team with 30+ assists?
sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*)  FROM game  WHERE ast_home >= 30 OR ast_away >= 30;

natural_query: Which game had the highest combined total of turnovers and steals?
sql_query: SELECT game_id, (tov_home + tov_away + stl_home + stl_away) AS total  FROM game  ORDER BY total DESC  LIMIT 1;

natural_query: What is the highest number of assists recorded by the Indiana Pacers in a single home game?
sql_query: SELECT MAX(ast_home)  FROM game  WHERE team_name_home = 'Indiana Pacers';
